mistake_reason: Injected FM-3.3 (Incorrect Verification): The WebSurfer validated the absence of 'plasmon'/'plasmonics' using flawed criteria and the wrong context. They performed keyword search on the article listing page instead of the actual article content and treated related-articles sidebar terms as evidence that the Diamond article mentioned plasmonics. This defective verification produced a false positive confirmation, leading the team to select the wrong article and conclude the nano-compound as 'gold' instead of the correct 'diamond'.
